se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom 1.2.7 发布, Bill of Materials for the VibeTags annotation processor. Import this BOM to get
        a coherent vibetags-annotations + vibetags-processor pair without specifying
        each version individually.

        Recommended setup — annotations on the compile classpath, processor on the
        annotation-processor path only (the processor jar pulls in slf4j/logback,
        which has no business on consumer code's compileClasspath):

        Maven:
            <dependencyManagement>
                <dependencies>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>se.deversity.vibetags</groupId>
                        <artifactId>vibetags-bom</artifactId>
                        <version>1.2.7</version>
                        <type>pom</type>
                        <scope>import</scope>
                    </dependency>
                </dependencies>
            </dependencyManagement>

        Gradle:
            implementation platform('se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom:1.2.7')
            annotationProcessor platform('se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom:1.2.7')
            compileOnly 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations'
            annotationProcessor 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-processor'

org.rspond.jmxmp:jmxmp-parent 1.0.3 发布, Modernized fork of the OpenDMK "jmx-optional" JMXMP connector (JSR-160 generic
    connector over TCP). Derived from the discontinued OpenDMK reference implementation
    (CDDL-1.0 / GPLv2 with Classpath Exception, dual license). Targets JDK 21+ with
    TLS client-certificate propagation, Subject.callAs dispatch, fail-closed access
    control, RFC 4616 SASL/PLAIN server, and hardened wire deserialization.
